warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: GRN Creation against an open PO or linked ASN for a user without the Warehouse Executive role; Repeating GRN creation as a Warehouse Executive in the same tenant; Comparing refusal or absence for the first persona with availability for the Warehouse Executive

args.need: sign in as the user without the Warehouse Executive role, attempt GRN creation against an open PO or linked ASN and record whether it is refused or absent, then repeat as a Warehouse Executive in the same tenant and record whether GRN creation is available

steps.note: No catalog step can open or assert the GRN workflow or switch between these role-specific personas.
Provides a final observable assertion after the tester's role-based checks, although it cannot establish GRN authorization.
